    FROM results
    JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId
    WHERE races.year = 2008
      AND races.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
      AND results.position = 1
      AND results.time IS NOT NULL
      AND results.time LIKE '%:%:%'
),

    SELECT races.raceId, results.time
    FROM results
    JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId

      AND results.position = (

WHERE champion_time.raceId = last_driver_time.raceId;

WITH
-- Get the lowest consumption threshold for each segment in 2013
min_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        MIN(ym.Consumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM
        yearmonth ym
    JOIN
        customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE
        SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY
        c.Segment
),

-- Get customers with the lowest consumption in each segment
lowest_consumers AS (
    SELECT
        ym.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        ym.Consumption
    FROM
        yearmonth ym
    JOIN
        customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    JOIN
        min_consumption mc ON c.Segment = mc.Segment AND ym.Consumption = mc.MinConsumption
    WHERE
        SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
),

-- Calculate total consumption and count of lowest consumers per segment
segment_stats AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ym.CustomerID) AS ConsumerCount
    FROM
        yearmonth ym
    JOIN
        lowest_consumers lc ON ym.CustomerID = lc.CustomerID AND c.Segment = lc.Segment
    JOIN
        customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE

        c.Segment,
        SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) AS Year,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM
        yearmonth y
    JOIN
        customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE
        c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY
        c.Segment, SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4)
),

segment_increases AS (
    SELECT
        yc.Segment,
        yc.TotalConsumption AS Consumption_2012,
        y2013.TotalConsumption AS Consumption_2013

        yearly_consumption y2013 ON yc.Segment = y2013.Segment AND yc.Year = '2012' AND y2013.Year = '2013'
),

        CASE

    PercentageChange
